blocks.en: We now study the properties of the spectra of bounded operators. Many of our most important results about the spectrum (including the results for the results below for compact operators) are derived by using a power series expansion for the resolvent. We now prove a fundamental theorem that is the analogue of the elementary calculus result on the convergence of geometric series.
blocks.zh: 现在研究有界算子的谱的性质. 关于谱的许多最重要的结果 (包括下面关于紧算子的结果所用的结果), 都是利用预解算子的幂级数展开导出的. 现在证明一个基本定理, 它是初等微积分中关于几何级数收敛的结果的类似物.

blocks.en: This theorem immediately gives us the following result, which says that the spectrum $\sigma(A)$ of a bounded operator $A$ lies in a bounded disk in the complex plane.
